decisions.reason: The source explicitly revises only Big Block prize parameters; the independent Small Block prize amount, winner count, and draw trigger remain unchanged.
Changing the Big Block prize amount and draw cadence does not alter which Big Block tickets are eligible or their post-draw burn and reset behavior.
The source changes Big Block parameters but does not change the manual prize-claim payout mode.
The number and recipient of tickets issued for a coded-referral mint remain unchanged despite the revised Big Block prize parameters.
The source retains the Big Block mechanism and does not change the requirement to expose its ticket counter in NFT metadata.
The revised Big Block amount and sales-based cadence do not necessarily alter royalty enforcement, royalty contributions to prize pools, or the rule that royalties create no tickets.
The source does not change the coded-referral commission amount or its automatic distribution.
The source does not change the number of no-referral tickets or selection of their recipient.
Revising Big Block prize parameters does not change the use of VRF for winner selection.
Although public APIs expose pool values, the source does not change their unauthenticated access policy or the categories of public information.
Badge selection and presentation are unrelated to the revised Big Block prize amount and draw cadence.
The product-rule revision does not change the requirement concerning deployment on the Base network.
